title: The Controversial plan for the park
subtitle: 国家公民 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 国家公民（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·国家与公民）
meta: 主题语境：国家公民（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·国家与公民）　|　核心词汇：controversial　|　正文 341 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 controversial 的用法与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1977 the baker wrote of ① a controversial plan for the park in the bill, and everybody in the bakery said at once that it was ② more controversial than the one named there the year before. Three weeks on, people still spoke of that morning, and of how the baker, who never explained anything, had done it without complaint and gone home; it was the controversial ones, my mother said, that people remembered longest.

It was ③ the most controversial plan for the park anybody in the bakery had ever seen, or so the bill for December 1971 claims. My mother, who had seen them all, thought it ④ too controversial to be of any use to anybody, and said as much to the customer who had come to help; the controversial ones, she used to say, were never the useful ones.

My uncle, who kept the tray at the far oven, meant something else entirely. He called the whole business ⑤ a controversial book about the war, and said that no customer in his right mind would call it ⑥ as controversial as the book about the war they had once had in the old bakery. He was never a man who cared whether a thing was controversial or not, and he said so.

By 1984 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the bill. What the line asked for was ⑦ something controversial, and nothing besides. The customer from the next bakery called the whole plan ⑧ quite controversial; everybody laughed, and then did exactly what he had said. After that the bill kept the names of the controversial ones only.

My mother said nothing at all. In 1987, with great care, she wrote of another controversial plan for the park in the same bill, and the work, which took two weeks, seemed ⑨ more controversial than anybody had expected. ⑩ The most controversial book about the war in the whole bakery, she said in 1989, was the one she could never quite name; the controversial ones, she added, are always the ones that stay.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. adj. 有争议（前置定语 a controversial plan for the park：1977 年面点师在账单里记下的那件有争议的方案）
B. adj. 有争议／引发争论（比较级 more controversial than：文中两处，一处比公园的方案，一处比预想）
C. adj. 有争议／引发争论（最高级 the most controversial：文中两处，见第 3、10 题）
D. adj. 有争议（表语 too controversial to do：母亲觉得它太有争议，反倒派不上用场）
E. adj. 引发争论（前置定语 a controversial book about the war：叔叔把整件事称作一桩引发争论的书）
F. adj. 引发争论（同级比较 as controversial as：拿眼前这桩跟旧日那桩写战争的书相比）
G. adj. 引发争论（后置定语 something controversial：修饰不定代词时须放在其后）
H. adj. 引发争论（受程度副词修饰 quite controversial：那位顾客的评价）

items.q: a controversial plan for the park
the most controversial plan for the park anybody
a controversial book about the war
The most controversial book about the war in

answers.why: controversial 意为“有争议”，1977 年面点师在账单里记下的是“一件有争议的方案”，此处作前置定语 a controversial plan for the park。
controversial 意为“有争议”，此处用比较级 more controversial than，拿它跟前一年记下的那一个相比。
controversial 意为“有争议”，账单上 十二月 那行字说它是糕饼铺里最有争议的一件，故用最高级 the most controversial plan for the park。
controversial 意为“有争议”，母亲认为这件东西“太有争议了，谁也用不上”，too controversial to do 表示“太……以致不能”。
controversial 意为“引发争论”，叔叔把整件事称作“一桩引发争论的书”，此处作前置定语 a controversial book about the war。
controversial 意为“引发争论”，叔叔不肯说它“跟旧日那桩写战争的书一样引发争论”，同级比较用 as controversial as。
controversial 意为“引发争论”，账单上那半行字要的是“引发争论的东西”，something 被形容词修饰时形容词须后置：something controversial。
controversial 意为“引发争论”，邻糕饼铺来的那位顾客认为这套计划“相当引发争论”，quite 修饰原级 controversial。
controversial 意为“引发争论”，1987 年那趟活儿“比任何人预想的都要引发争论”，故用比较级 more controversial than。
controversial 意为“引发争论”，母亲 1989 年说的是“整个糕饼铺里最引发争论的那一桩”，故用最高级 the most controversial book about the war。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1977 年，面点师在账单里记下了一件有争议的方案。（a controversial plan for the park）
人人都说它比前一年记下的那一个更有争议。（more controversial than …）
母亲觉得它太有争议，谁也用不上。（too controversial to …）
叔叔把整件事称作一桩引发争论的书。（a controversial book about the war）
他说，谁也不会认为它跟旧日那桩写战争的书一样引发争论。（as controversial as …）
到了 1984 年，账单上只剩半行字：要的是一件引发争论的东西。（something controversial）
answers: In 1977 the baker wrote of a controversial plan for the park in the bill.
Everybody said it was more controversial than the one named there the year before.
My mother thought it too controversial to be of any use to anybody.
My uncle called the whole business a controversial book about the war.
He said nobody would call it as controversial as the book about the war they had once had.
By 1984 the bill asked for nothing but something controversial.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 controversial 的 3 种不同用法（前置定语、表语、比较级／最高级、后置定语等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1977 the baker wrote of a controversial plan for the park in the bill, and nobody forgot it.
It was the most controversial plan for the park in the bakery, or so the bill says.
My mother thought it too controversial to be of any use, and said so plainly.
My uncle called the whole business a controversial book about the war, and nobody argued with him.
The customer from the next bakery called the plan quite controversial, and everybody laughed.
The controversial ones, my mother said, are always the ones that stay.
